plan.notes: Source: official Loyola Marymount University Academic Bulletin (bulletin.lmu.edu, Westchester main campus, 1 LMU Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90045) - 'Computer Science, B.S.' program page and its official program PDF (https://bulletin.lmu.edu/schools-colleges/science-engineering/computer-science/computer-science-bs/computer-science-bs.pdf), section 'Curriculum (124 Semester Hours): A typical course of study leading to the B.S. degree in computer science'. Catalog year 2026-2027 confirmed as the current '2026-2027 Edition' on the bulletin homepage (retrieved 2026-09-30). Transcription method: program PDF downloaded from bulletin.lmu.edu and text-extracted (pdftotext + pymupdf cross-check), transcribed term by term, every term total re-summed against the chart's published term totals (16/16/17-18/17-18/16/16/14-18/12-18). NOTE - LMU disambiguation: this is Loyola Marymount University (Los Angeles, CA, private, bulletin.lmu.edu), NOT Lincoln Memorial University (Harrogate, TN, lmunet.edu), which also brands as 'LMU' and also publishes a BS Computer Science plan - the Lincoln Memorial documents were identified and excluded. CAVEATS: (1) Variable elective slots were encoded at their range MINIMUMS so the encoded total equals the catalog's published degree minimum: Fall Y2 'Elective 3-4'->3, Spring Y2 'Elective 3-4'->3, Fall Y4 'Elective 2-6'->2, Spring Y4 'Elective 0-6'->0 (the 0-credit slot means no elective is needed at the minimum). Encoded total = 16+16+17+17+16+16+14+12 = 124, exactly the catalog's published minimum of 124 semester hours ('Graduation Requirements: Completion of at least 124 semester hours'); the chart's printed degree range is 124-136 and term ranges as printed above. (2) Footnote 1: only ONE of CMSI 2021 Web Application Development or CMSI 2022 Mobile Application Development is required (students may take both); the official chart lists both (2 cr each, one per sophomore semester) and both are transcribed as printed. (3) Footnote 2: exploration electives that also satisfy University Core (e.g., CMSI 3700, CMSI 3710, CMSI 3920) free up additional free-elective slots. (4) MATH 361 Probability and Mathematical Statistics (Spring Y3, as printed in the chart) is WAIVED for students who take CMSI 4320 Cognitive Systems Design - in that case the major minimum drops by 4 semester hours; transcribed as printed with the waiver noted here. (5) CMSI 1900 Exploring Computer Science (0 cr) is required for all incoming first-year CS majors (transfer students entering after their first semester are exempt); ORNT 1000 Intro to LMU for First Years (0 cr) also printed in the chart - both flagged required_zero. (6) FFYS 1000 First Year Seminar transcribed at 4 semester hours as printed in the chart (catalog course listing shows 3-4). (7) The official sequence chart publishes no course prerequisites, so all prereq lists are empty - none were invented. (8) No summer terms in the official chart; 8 semesters. (9) University Core minimum is 32 semester hours; the chart satisfies it via FFYS 1000, RHET 1000, five 4-hour 'University Core' slots, and the two 'Elective or University Core if needed' slots.
